criteria_results.title: Memo organized by NST requirement number
criteria_results.reasoning: Part IV is organized with headings Requirement 1 through Requirement 14, each matching an NST requirement number.

criteria_results.title: Memo includes a summary risk assessment
criteria_results.reasoning: The Bottom Line section and the Summary Scorecard give an overall compliance verdict (not submittable; 71 gaps by severity) and a risk level for each requirement.

criteria_results.title: Memo includes a prioritized list of revisions needed
criteria_results.reasoning: The Bottom Line gives a numbered priority list of revisions tied to the May 3 deadline, and Part VI.A sorts the items into tiers.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies board composition does not achieve majority
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 1-A says 3 of 7 (42.9%) is not a majority and fails NST 1.2.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends remediation for board majority shortfall
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends 4/2/1, 3/1/1 or 9-seat 5/3/1 board structures plus a self-executing majority covenant.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies GSD removal standard mismatch (notice vs. approval)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 2-A says section 5.3 allows removal by unanimous Security Committee vote on 30 days' notice, whereas the NST requires CFIUS prior written approval.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Recommends remediation for GSD removal standard
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends replacing section 5.3 with a requirement for CFIUS prior written approval.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies consultation right as exceeding economic-rights-only
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 3-A flags the section 6.1(c) consultation right on sale, merger or dissolution as prohibited by NST 3.3, which limits Meridian to economic rights only.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies board observer right as exceeding economic-rights-only
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 3-B flags the section 6.1(d) Board Observer, who attends all meetings, as prohibited by NST 3.3.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends removing governance rights beyond economic rights
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends deleting section 6.1(c), section 6.1(d) and the related provisions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies audit frequency discrepancy (annual vs. semiannual)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 8-A says section 12.1 provides annual audits against the NST's semiannual requirement, halving the frequency.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Recommends increasing audit frequency to semiannual
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends audits every six months.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies TCP timeline extension (60 days vs. 90 days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 7-A identifies 90 days in section 9.4 against the NST's 60 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies TCP triggering-event discrepancy (closing vs. Effective Date)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 7-A identifies that the NST measures from Closing while the draft measures from the Effective Date (CFIUS clearance), and discusses the May 15 / June 30 timeline and how the two clocks diverge.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies incident reporting window tripled (24 hours vs. 72 hours)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 10-A identifies 72 hours in section 14.2 against the NST's 24 hours from discovery.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies incident reporting trigger change (discovery vs. GSD determination)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 10-A identifies the trigger change from discovery by any personnel to the GSD's determination, a gatekeeping step the NST forbids.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies subcontracting threshold raised from 10% to 25%
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 12-A identifies the 25% threshold in section 11.3 against the NST's 10%.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies 'direct' equity qualifier narrows subcontracting scope
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 12-A flags that the 'direct' qualifier excludes joint-venture and indirect structures.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies omission of forced divestiture from remedies
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 14-C says section 17.1 lists penalties, injunctive relief and DOJ referral but omits forced divestiture.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies survival clause limits CFIUS discretion
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 13-B identifies automatic termination with a 12-month wind-down that overrides CFIUS's sole discretion over survival, including indefinite survival.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies ITAR/EAR-controlled data omitted from access restrictions
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 4-A says section 8.1 covers only Classified Information and Classified Facilities and omits ITAR/EAR data.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies government contracts notice period shortened (90 to 60 days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 11-A identifies 60 days in section 10.2 against the NST's 90 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies indirect notice mechanism (via Security Committee)
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 11-A flags that notice goes to the Security Committee, which then informs CFIUS, rather than directly to CFIUS.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies annual compliance report deadline extension mechanism
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 9-A flags the clause 'or such later date as agreed by the Third-Party Monitor' as a prohibited extension of the fixed March 31 deadline.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Identifies CFIUS omitted from amendment consent requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 13-A says section 18.1 requires only Saxonbrook, Meridian and the Trustee to sign amendments and omits CFIUS.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Identifies missing 30-day monitor report delivery deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 8-B says section 12.2 sets no report deadline, against the NST's 30 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Identifies penalty cap omits transaction-value alternative
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 14-A says the $250,000 cap omits the transaction-value measure ($588,285,000), cites 50 U.S.C. section 4565, and notes that exposure is understated.

criteria_results.title: References the May 3, 2025 execution deadline as context for urgency
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo states the May 3, 2025 deadline (12 days away) as the reason for urgency.

criteria_results.title: Identifies commercially motivated deviations where applicable
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo flags deviations as deliberate concessions to Meridian, such as the 25% threshold 'specifically calibrated' to exclude JVs, the intentional ITAR narrowing and the 'firm' observer right, and says they still fail the NST.

criteria_results.title: Correct identification of parties and matter context
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Meridian and Saxonbrook and CFIUS Case No. CFIUS-2025-00147, and refers to Meridian obtaining a 51% interest.

criteria_results.title: Each gap analysis includes NST language and Mitigation Agreement language
criteria_results.reasoning: Most gaps have separate NST and Draft v3.2 language blocks, well over 10.

criteria_results.title: Each gap analysis includes a remediation recommendation
criteria_results.reasoning: Every gap includes a 'Recommended fix', across more than 70 gaps.

criteria_results.title: Each gap is characterized by nature and severity
criteria_results.reasoning: Each gap heading describes the nature of the gap and carries a Critical/High/Medium/Low severity tag.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Recommends aligning TCP timeline to 60 days from closing
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 7-A recommends 60 days after Closing (the earlier of the two measures) or simply tracking NST 7.2.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Recommends restoring 24-hour reporting and discovery trigger
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 10-A recommends a 24-hour report from discovery by any personnel.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Recommends restoring CFIUS sole discretion on survival
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 13-B recommends replacing section 18.2 with NST 13.2-13.4, preserving CFIUS's sole discretion.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Recommends adding CFIUS as required consenting party for amendments
criteria_results.reasoning: Gap 13-A recommends replacing section 18.1 with NST 13.1, which requires CFIUS consent.

criteria_results.title: References precedent matrix or market practice for context
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo repeatedly cites Precedents A-E from the matrix, for example 'all five precedents use 24 hours from discovery'.
